subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about funded accounts for your UK wallet. One number sharpens the case: wallet and instant payment flows convert 19 percent better than card-only checkout (Worldpay via IBTimes 2023), yet a banking-and-payments customer still costs roughly 258 dollars to acquire (firstpagesage 2026). That spread is where funded-event screening and incrementality decide your real cost per funded account. We hold out a control group so paid funded users read as incremental to your organic high-intent installers. Worth comparing against your current mix?
angle: fresh angle: wallet/instant payments convert 19% better than card-only (sourced) vs ~$258 banking/payments CAC band
